title: Tuttnauer 3870EA bench-top autoclave
manualMd: Steam sterilizer with cycles for liquids, dry goods, and waste. Standard liquid cycle: 121 °C / 30 min. Standard waste cycle: 121 °C / 60 min (longer to penetrate the load).
hazardsMd:
- Burn hazard: chamber stays >100 °C after cycle end. Door release will scald.
- Always wait until the pressure gauge reads zero AND the door release pin retracts before opening.
- Liquid cycle uses slow exhaust to prevent boil-over. Don't use a dry-goods cycle on bottles.

operations.title: Pre-run check
operations.bodyMd:
1. Check water-reservoir level.
2. Inspect the door gasket for damage.
3. Confirm the printer (if installed) has paper.
4. Place autoclave-indicator tape on every item; the dark stripes confirm process temperature.

operations.title: Loading liquids
operations.bodyMd: Use heat-stable bottles, NEVER full to the top — fill ≤ 75%. Loosen caps to prevent bottle rupture. Place inside a secondary tray to catch any boil-over. Select 'Liquids' cycle (slow exhaust).

operations.title: Loading waste
operations.bodyMd: Use red autoclave bags. Leave the bag mouth open with a cuff so steam penetrates the load. Place inside a secondary autoclave pan. Select 'Waste/Gravity' cycle, 60 min.

operations.title: Door won't open
operations.bodyMd: Pressure has not equalized. Wait — never force. If the gauge stays high after 30 min the pressure-relief valve may be stuck; tag out and call service.

operations.title: Cycle aborted mid-run
operations.bodyMd: Most often water-reservoir empty (alarm should fire). Refill, restart. If no obvious cause, log the cycle as 'aborted — re-run' and call service.

operations.title: Post-use
operations.bodyMd: Wait for the door to release naturally. Wear heat-rated gloves. Remove the load to a designated cooling area. Wipe the chamber gasket dry. Log the cycle in the autoclave logbook.
